note: Economic indicator tickers, date ranges, and market reaction ticker are all user-supplied at runtime. Fields are fetched automatically by the module — users do not need to specify them.

series.description: Consensus average forecast for the user-supplied economic indicator. Also fetches ECO_SURVEY_MEDIAN, ECO_SURVEY_HIGH, ECO_SURVEY_LOW, BN_SURVEY_NUMBER, ECO_RELEASE_DT.
Realized/actual release value for the user-supplied economic indicator
Market instrument to measure price reaction around the release (e.g. a bond yield, FX rate, equity index). Ticker entered separately by the user.
